scope: Phase 5 stabilization of the five-command core and bounded compatibility handlers

items.evidence: Core unit test and all three Phase 5 fixed slices discovered the declared source resource.
items.limitations: Discovery is format-aware but does not infer project-specific i18n architecture.

items.evidence: Candidate extraction and locked-constraint tests pass; all three slices produced a canonical glossary file.
items.limitations: Candidate extraction is intentionally conservative; small slices can correctly produce zero candidates and semantic term quality remains human-reviewed.

items.evidence: JSON and Apple slices passed; Android surfaced an expected informational skipped-resource finding without a blocking error.
items.limitations: Structural and placeholder checks do not judge translation meaning or naturalness.

items.evidence: Every fixed slice generated an independent-review packet containing Project Memory, Glossary, deterministic results, and aligned segments.
items.limitations: The packet is an input to an independent reviewer, not an automatic semantic approval.

items.evidence: Fresh-context review payloads were accepted for JSON, Android, and Apple slices.
items.limitations: Reviewer quality is outside deterministic CLI control.

items.evidence: JSON and Apple slices remained needs_human_confirmation until the exact open finding was confirmed; invalid IDs are rejected by the Skill test.
items.limitations: Confirmation records a human decision; it does not replace product-owner judgment.

items.evidence: Reports correctly produced needs_human_confirmation, needs_attention, and ready outcomes across the clean-install and fixed-slice runs.
items.limitations: Ready is limited to Localize Anything evidence and explicitly does not claim project build/test release approval.

items.evidence: scan writes source/target locales and selected resources; confirmed knowledge is imported into the memory boundary.
items.limitations: Project-native build configuration and runtime locale behavior remain Coding Agent responsibilities.

items.evidence: Canonical glossary.json, stable concept IDs, locked preferred/forbidden targets, and preservation behavior are tested.
items.limitations: The core does not infer a complete product ontology or guarantee natural translation choices.

items.evidence: Only confirmed terminology, translation memory, style rules, decisions, and approved packs enter Project Memory/Glossary.
items.limitations: Knowledge Pack is not retained as a user-facing core concept; unconfirmed data is ignored.

items.evidence: Stable IDs, alignment, source-hash changes, and stale/new/unchanged classification pass parity tests.
items.limitations: No legacy workflow or artifact lifecycle is carried into the core.

items.scope: core JSON and structured YAML/TOML handlers
items.evidence: JSON completed the clean-install end-to-end flow; YAML/TOML round-trip and placeholder tests pass.
items.limitations: Full YAML syntax validation uses the optional yaml extra; complex block scalars, anchors, flow collections, and TOML multiline/array strings are intentionally bounded.

items.evidence: Extensive string/array/plural/qualifier/placeholder tests plus a ru fixed-slice scan/check/review/report run.
items.limitations: Compose strings, layouts, assets, build variants, locale behavior, and APK packaging remain project work.

items.evidence: Round-trip/placeholder tests and a ru fixed-slice run validated with plutil.
items.limitations: Xcode project files, storyboards, build settings, and application code are outside the handler.

items.evidence: Catalog round-trip and placeholder tests pass; core review pairing reads target localizations.
items.limitations: Only declared catalog resources are checked; project-level Xcode behavior is not.

items.evidence: PO parsing, plural/header/placeholder validation and core review identity pairing pass.
items.limitations: Semantic translation quality and project-native msgmerge/release tooling remain external.

items.evidence: Both XLIFF versions round-trip with inline-tag and placeholder checks.
items.limitations: Vendor-specific extensions are only covered when preserved by the bounded parser.

items.evidence: Markdown/HTML extraction, rebuild, links, tags, scripts, and code preservation tests pass.
items.limitations: No automatic fallback or full HTML attribute/image-text localization.

items.evidence: SRT/WebVTT cue identity, timing, tags, and placeholder round-trip tests pass.
items.limitations: Reading speed, line breaks, cultural context, and rendered playback require review.

items.evidence: CSV/TSV/XLSX round-trip tests preserve coordinates, keys, formulas, and non-text cells.
items.limitations: The handler targets a locale-table convention and does not infer arbitrary workbook semantics.

items.evidence: WML context extraction and pinned public fixture checks pass.
items.limitations: The retained scenario adapter is extract-only; it is not a general five-command translation path.

items.evidence: DOCX/DOTX/DOCM/DOTM visible-text round-trip tests preserve OpenXML parts and macro bytes.
items.limitations: Rendered-layout fidelity, images, embedded objects, legacy .doc, and encrypted documents need separate handling.

items.scope: wheel install from a fresh clone and fresh venv
items.evidence: localize-anything 0.4.1 installed with one localize entrypoint; five commands ran end-to-end; deleted modules were absent from wheel and import resolution.
items.limitations: Repository-only protocol/adapter catalogs are validation assets, not runtime package data.
